structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Private institutions of higher education; human research review committees
law.text: The human research review committee at each private institution of higher education that conducts human research, as that term is defined in § 32.1-162.16, shall submit to the Governor, the General Assembly, and the president of the institution or his designee at least annually a report on the human research projects reviewed and approved by the committee and any significant deviations from approved proposals.
